datasets.title: The transcriptional profile of extracellular vesicles extracted from cerebrospinal flood in patients with multiple system atrophy, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
datasets.summary: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) play a role in intercellular communication by transferring proteins and/or transcripts.  The profile of proteins and/or transcripts in EVs may differentiate multiple system atrophy (MSA) from Parkinson's disease. In the present study, we performed transcriptome analysis of EVs extracted from cerebrospinal flood of patients with multiple system atrophy, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
datasets.overall_design: Exosomes were extracted from the cerebrospinal fluid, collected via spinal tap and frozen at -20°C using the MagCapture Exosome Isolation Kit PS Ver.2(FujiFilm, #290-84103) method. RNA was then purified using the exoRNeasy Midi Kit (77144, Qiagen).

datasets.title: Expression data from oligodendroglial cell line
datasets._606ad7: 索臻(SOGEN)出品·公共数据标注语料·加微信bioinformaticsboy进群持续获取增量·grswsci.top/analyze
datasets.summary: Coexpression of alpha-synuclein and p25alpha in an oligodendroglial cell line elicites a degenerative response that relies on aggregation and phosphorylation of alpha-synuclein at Ser129 We used microarray analysis to detail the changes in gene expression caused by alpha-synuclein aggregation followed by cellular degeneration
datasets.overall_design: Alpha-synuclein was coexpressed with p25alpha in an oligodendroglial cell line and mRNA was isolated at 8, 12, and 16 hrs after transfection. Gene expression was analyzed by two identical microarray set-ups
datasets.study_design: 大鼠少突胶质细胞系OLN共表达α-synuclein与p25α，对比空载体对照，微阵列分析时间序列基因表达变化

evidence.relevant: 研究α-synuclein与p25α在少突胶质细胞中共表达引起的聚集和变性，这正是多系统萎缩的核心病理机制，细胞模型为其公认模型。
evidence.sequencing_type: GEO数据类型为Expression profiling by array，提供CEL文件并用MAS 5.0处理，实验设计明确检测mRNA表达，属于典型的mRNA表达谱芯片实验。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本为大鼠细胞系，非人类患者，无生存时间或状态字段，完全无法做患者生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较是转染p25α vs 空载体对照，属基因操作而非药物治疗干预，无药物对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 对照组为空载体转染的同一细胞系，不是独立健康组织或正常细胞，不存在疾病vs正常差异设计
evidence.correlation: 全部12个样本均来源于细胞系，无独立疾病患者样本，不满足患者数≥16的要求，无法做表达-相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 所有12个样本均来自OLN少突胶质细胞系（oligodendroglial cell line stably expressing alpha-synuclein），为已建系的永生化细胞，经瞬时转染后提取RNA进行芯片分析，符合cell_line定义。

datasets.title: The expression profiling of the early stage of multiple system atrophy model mice
datasets.summary: Global transcriptional analysis of the brain of multiple system atrophy model mice after synuclein induction by tamoxifen. Multiple system atrophy (MSA) is pathologically characterized by accumulation of phosphorylated α-synuclein in the oligodendrocytes. The pathophisiological mechinism under the early staige of disease pregression has been unknown. To clarify molecular alteration just after α-synuclein overexpression in the oligodendrocytes, we performed whole transcriptome analysis of the brain obtained from MSA model mice and control at 10 days after α-synuclein induction.
datasets.overall_design: Knock-in mice harboring human synuclein (Syn) gene with stop codon between loxp recognition sites were mated with mice expressing cre/estrogen receptor under the proteolipid protein (plp) promoter, which is an oligodendrocyte specific marker. Resulting mice (plp-Syn; Cre+/-) express human synuclein in the oligodedrocyte only after tamoxifen injection, and used as MSA model mice in this analysis. MSA model mice or control (plp-Syn; Cre-/-, n=3, respectively) were sacrified under deep anesthesia and brains were quickly removed. Right hemisphere of the brain from MSA model mice and control were subjected to transcriptome analysis or qRT-PCR.
datasets.study_design: MSA转基因小鼠脑组织与Cre-对照，bulk表达芯片转录组分析

evidence.relevant: MSA模型小鼠（PLP-Syn;Cre+/-）全脑转录组，研究MSA早期分子机制，主体和样本均为目标疾病。
evidence.sequencing_type: Expression profiling by array，total RNA，常规基因表达芯片，目的为全转录组mRNA丰度分析，无特殊ncRNA富集证据，判为mRNA microarray。
evidence.survival_analysis: 小鼠模型，非人类患者，无生存数据
evidence.treatment: 他莫昔芬仅作Cre诱导工具，全组注射，核心比较为基因型非药物
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 对照为Cre-同窝对照，属遗传操作对照非真健康对照
evidence.correlation: 仅3只MSA模型动物，不足16且非人类样本
evidence.sample_source: 转基因小鼠经他莫昔芬体内诱导后处死取全脑，直接提取总RNA，未分选细胞、未离体培养，属in vivo组织直接测序，判为tissue。
